# Deepwork Labs — Design System

> Machine-readable index. Fetch this file first; it is tiny by design.
> Full guide: README.md. Hub page (open in browser): deepwork-labs.html

## How to read this system (agents)
- To LEARN the system, read source, not pages: mix.css, loading.js, _art.js, pg-app.css, pg-shell.js. All ≤28KB.
- HTML pages are compositions — open in a browser, do NOT fetch as text.
- NEVER fetch build artifacts whole (hundreds of KB): "Deepwork AI - Landing (standalone).html".
- Fastest "use it" path: mix.css (tokens) → SKILL.md (rules) → the one CSS/JS file for your task.

## Foundations (read to learn)
- mix.css        ~12KB  all design tokens + base components (source of truth)
- loading.js     ~6KB   spinners / bars / streaming typer / agent faces
- _art.js        ~14KB  generative ASCII art library
- SKILL.md       ~2KB   load order + rules

## Application layer (build products)
- pg-app.css     ~28KB  shell, sidebar, cards, data table, drawer, pills, pipeline
- pg-shell.js    ~9KB   injects sidebar + Cmd-K palette (reads <body data-screen>)
- pg-detail.css  ~13KB  editor + modals + realistic shelf
- pg-detail.js   ~21KB  planogram editor logic
- pg-review.js   ~22KB  approval workspace (focus/batch, reasoning, bulk)
- pg-products.js pg-catalog.js pg-report.js pg-pdf.js pg-ask.js  per-screen logic

## Entry points (open in browser, do not fetch whole)
- deepwork-labs.html   design-system hub
- index.html, Open Field.html   foundations home + spec
- preview/*.html   one component per page

## Products & artifacts (open in browser)
- planogram-*.html   Planogram product (9 screens)
- openkt-landing.html, planogram-landing.html   marketing
- template-article.html, template-feed.html   compositions

## Do NOT fetch whole (generated)
- Deepwork AI - Landing (standalone).html   ~769KB self-contained bundle

## Load order
mix.css → _art.js → loading.js  (foundations)
pg-app.css → pg-shell.js  (apps; shell auto-injects from <body data-screen="…">)
